mapper.select: select * from "conversation" where (sender_id = #{senderId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId}) or (sender_id = #{receiverId} and receiver_id = #{senderId})
mapper.insert: insert into "conversation"(sender_id, receiver_id, last_message_id, sender_last_message_id, receiver_last_message_id, sender_unread_count, receiver_unread_count, sender_deleted, receiver_deleted, create_time, update_time) values (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{lastMessageId}, #{senderLastMessageId}, #{receiverLastMessageId}, #{senderUnreadCount}, #{receiverUnreadCount}, #{senderDeleted}, #{receiverDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
